section_summary.extract_value: This section reviews the influence of aging on body image and sexual health, discussing four studies that examined the relationship between age and body appreciation with inconsistent results. The text presents findings from Augustus-Horvath and Tylka (2011), Swami et al. (2008a), Tiggemann and McCourt (2013), and Swami et al. (2014), concluding that positive correlations between age and body appreciation align better with gerontology literature. The section also discusses how sexual function declines with age but sexual satisfaction and distress levels show different patterns, suggesting that older women's sexual health may depend more on non-sexuality-related factors and body appreciation may serve as a protective buffer against age-related sexual distress.
